title: Remove a deprecated function and migrate every caller, output unchanged
prompt: We're releasing 2.5, and docs/deprecations.md says `tally.money.fmt()` is removed in 2.5. Migrate every caller in the codebase to `Money.format()`, then delete `fmt()`. Everything the app prints must stay exactly the same, character for character. When you're done, nothing should raise a DeprecationWarning, and the tests must pass with `python3 -W error::DeprecationWarning -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`.
